items.text: Fed: Inflation remains elevated, drops earlier description of that owing in part to supply shocks.
❗ Fed Policymakers see 2.3% GDP growth in 2026 versus 2.2% in June, see longer-run growth at 2.0% vs 2.0% in June.
❗ Fed Policymakers see end-2026 PCE inflation at 3.7% versus 3.6% in June; core seen at 3.4% versus 3.3%.
